documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Pellwood Systems (fictional).
In this document "PSH" means Pellwood Systems. Pellwood AB reports customer concentration of 22.3% for FY2024. Pellwood Systems reports approximately capex of $13m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Pellwood Systems reports interest cover of 2.5x for FY2025. Pellwood Systems reports available liquidity of $15.8m for FY2025 on a reported basis.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Pellwood Systems (fictional).
Pellwood Ltd reports customer concentration of 24.8% for FY2024. Pellwood Systems reports capex of $13.5m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Pellwood Systems reports EBITDA of $35.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Pellwood Systems: revenue for FY2025 on a reported basis — not provided.

documents.text:
Compliance certificate — Pellwood Systems (fictional).
Pellwood Systems reports interest cover of 2.1x for FY2025. Pellwood Systems reports available liquidity of $12.9m for FY2025 on a adjusted (management definition) basis.
